raw_segments.text: Just so Hurrah, you are a prophet. Oh, we shall get on together Karamazov
Do you know what delights me most is that you treat me quite like an equal, but we are not equals
No, we are not you are better, but we shall get on
Do you know all this last month? I've been saying to myself
Either we shall be friends at once forever or we shall part enemies to the grave
